headline: Alfa Laval to Acquire Maritime Software Firm NAVTOR for $700 Million
summary: Swedish industrial group Alfa Laval has agreed to acquire vessel-performance software provider NAVTOR AS for $700 million in an all-cash transaction to expand its digital offering for the maritime sector.
why: Alfa Laval AB is a Swedish provider of heat transfer, separation, and fluid handling technologies serving industrial and marine sectors.

impacts.why: Alfa Laval is spending $700 million in cash to acquire NAVTOR AS.
